news.title: Rajinikanth's Dharman Eyes Pongal 2027 Theatrical Launch
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's 173rd feature film, Dharman, is gearing up for a grand theatrical arrival during Pongal 2027. Directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and backed by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, the film's production is moving at a fast pace with intense action sequences. The project also features Ram Pothineni in a prominent role alongside a star-studded cast including Simran and Raashii Khanna.

news.title: Speculation Surrounds Mahesh Babu's Next Cinematic Venture
news.summary: As Mahesh Babu wraps up SS Rajamouli's upcoming directorial Varanasi ahead of its April 2027 worldwide release, discussions regarding his next film are intensifying. Recent updates reveal that Lokesh Kanagaraj's production banner G Squad has announced a collaboration with Mythri Movie Makers, sparking strong rumors among fans. However, no official confirmation has been made regarding whether Mahesh and Lokesh will team up for an upcoming project.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address Backlash Over The Paradise Dialogue
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela recently addressed online criticism regarding a specific line in their latest box-office hit, The Paradise. The director explained that a crucial backstory explaining the line was edited out to keep the runtime in check, causing the dialogue to land differently than intended. Meanwhile, the film continues its strong commercial run, aiming to cross the Rs. 150 crore gross mark over its opening weekend.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Serves Striking Retro Glam in New Photoshoot
news.summary: Actor Taapsee Pannu recently captured attention with a bold vintage-inspired photoshoot featuring voluminous curls and a black-and-gold floral mini dress. While her recent big-screen outings faced box-office hurdles, she continues filming for her upcoming project Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?. The actor remains selective about her film choices, focusing exclusively on roles that bring her creative fulfillment.

news.title: Sai Durga Tej Starrer Sambarala Yeti Gattu to Keep Its Sankranti Date
news.summary: Despite overlapping release announcements with Chiranjeevi's Kaaka, the team behind Sambarala Yeti Gattu has confirmed they will hold firm on their scheduled Sankranti arrival. Producer Chaitanya Reddy stated that post-production is nearing completion while shooting is fully wrapped. The mass action entertainer, directed by Rohith KP, features Sai Durga Tej alongside Aishwarya Lekshmi, Jagapathi Babu, and other prominent actors.

news.title: NTR Set to Restart Dragon Filming in Mumbai This October
news.summary: Actor NTR is gearing up to return to the sets of his upcoming film Dragon following a brief hiatus due to a shoulder injury. Director Prashanth Neel has continued filming other sequences in the meantime, while a two-week action schedule is lined up in Mumbai starting October 10th. The high-profile project co-stars Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is racing through the final schedule of January 12 Vidudala, with plans to wrap up principal photography by mid-November. The upcoming schedule kicks off in Ooty in early October, followed by overseas song shoots, while GV Prakash Kumar handles the background score and dubbing. The film features Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty in lead roles.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum on Day Three
news.summary: Nani's latest outing, The Paradise, has continued its stellar theatrical run with steady collections on its third day. Backed by strong advance bookings and massive turnout from family audiences on the holiday, the film is riding high on massive euphoria. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the movie stands as the actor's biggest career opener to date.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Unique Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has been unveiled in Hyderabad, showcasing a vibrant mix of youthful romance and unexpected suspense. Starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the movie follows a carefree young man whose life turns upside down after his romantic interest mysteriously vanishes. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the musical entertainer is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Fresh Visuals from Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Highlight Grandeur and Spiritual Aura
news.summary: The highly anticipated mythological film Ramayana has released striking new promotional material featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey as Ram, Sita, and Lakshman against a breathtaking natural background. Additionally, the makers revealed the first look of Yash as the formidable king of Lanka, Ravana, radiating an intense and regal presence. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Part 1 of the epic is slated for a Diwali 2026 release, followed by Part 2 in Diwali 2027.

news.title: Manga Srinivas Directs Chakkora, Promising a Fresh Spin on Telugu Love Stories
news.summary: Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird highlights a lighthearted protagonist named Ravana Brahma whose world alters dramatically when he falls for Julie, played by Malaika T. Vasupal. The narrative pivots from a playful chase into an emotional puzzle when the female lead suddenly disappears, uncovering hidden secrets from her past. Backed by High Joy Commercials and VIP – Vintage Iconic Pictures, the film hits theatres globally on October 9.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Pulls Strong Weekend Numbers Despite Mixed Early Reviews
news.summary: Despite encountering a risky midweek premiere and mixed critical responses, Nani's starrer The Paradise has posted impressive box office numbers, raking in a worldwide gross of 136 crore in its first three days. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the project witnessed a surge in collections across Telugu states on its third day while steadily marching toward the $2 million mark overseas. The core team recently celebrated this commercial momentum at a success event alongside special guest Mohan Babu.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Shooting for Dragon in Mumbai Following Recovery
news.summary: Actor NTR is preparing to return to work for his pan-India project Dragon, directed by Prashanth Neel. After recovering from a shoulder injury that kept him sidelined for nearly two months, the actor will join co-star Anil Kapoor in Mumbai on October 10 for a 15-day action schedule. The Mythri Movie Makers production is currently slated for a theatrical release in June 2027.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Faces Crucial Box Office Test on Monday
news.summary: Nani's big-budget release The Paradise opened to strong box office figures but received mixed reviews from audiences and critics regarding its emotional depth and screenplay. Trade estimates indicate the movie grossed around ₹120 crore by Saturday and aims toward a ₹220 crore target. Its performance on Monday will be vital in determining whether it can recover investments across various territories.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for the Anticipated Epic Ramayana
news.summary: The upcoming multi-lingual adaptation Ramayana has released striking new promotional images featuring Yash as Ravana alongside the core trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra and Monster Mind Creations, the big-budget project features a score by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The ambitious retelling is scheduled to hit theaters across two parts for Diwali 2026 and Diwali 2027.

news.title: Makers of Nagarjuna's King100 Plan Special Promotional Teaser for Tabu
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone project King100 is gearing up to unveil a dedicated character introduction video for actor Tabu, who plays a primary female lead. The movie reunites the 90s on-screen pair years after their classic hit Ninne Pelladutha. Directed by Ra Karthik and produced by Annapurna Studios and Manam Enterprises, the film is scheduled for release on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda's Historical Drama 'Ranabaali' Expands Promotion With Docu-Series
news.summary: To build excitement for the upcoming theatrical release of 'Ranabaali', the team behind the Rahul Sankrityan directorial has announced a four-part promotional documentary series titled 'Ranabaali: Never Forget'. Highlighting two years of research into historical events in Rayalaseema, the series will feature cast members Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna alongside the director discussing the project. The film itself is scheduled to hit theaters on October 16, 2026.

news.title: BRS Working President KTR Applauds Nani's 'The Paradise' After Theater Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR caught a screening of Nani's latest release, 'The Paradise', at Hyderabad's Sudarshan Theatre alongside various public representatives. He praised the cast and crew, including director Srikanth Odela, for delivering an impactful cinematic portrayal of Telangana's culture and the historical struggles of oppressed communities. KTR commended the authentic local dialect and narrative strength that highlight collective resistance.

news.title: Industry Buzz Points to Stronger OTT Valuations for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Recent trade chatter suggests that streaming platforms are willing to offer higher prices for female-driven projects featuring Rashmika Mandanna compared to those starring Sai Pallavi. Insiders attribute this trend to Rashmika's heavy social media following and her involvement in multiple high-profile pan-Indian box office successes. This market advantage was reportedly reinforced by a major digital deal secured for her upcoming MS Subbulakshmi biopic.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Ticket Sales on Day 3
news.summary: Despite mixed initial reviews, the Nani-led film The Paradise held its ground firmly by selling 252K tickets on BookMyShow during its third day. The project, bankrolled by Sudhakar Cherukuri and directed by Srikanth Odela, continues to exhibit strong momentum at the box office. The core team recently interacted with the media to discuss their experiences and ongoing box-office performance.

news.title: Wildcard Entrant Mithilesh Exits Bigg Boss Telugu 10 With Cash Offer
news.summary: In a surprising turn of events during Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, recent wildcard contestant Mithilesh chose to accept a Rs. 15 lakh temptation offer and walked out of the house. Entering the reality show with a strong reputation for his fitness and gameplay, Mithilesh defended his abrupt departure by stating that he could not foresee winning under the current house dynamics. This sudden exit marks a historic first within 24 hours of a wildcard entry in the show.

news.title: Nani Praises Cast and Crew at The Paradise Media Event
news.summary: Lead actor Nani expressed his joy over audiences ultimately embracing his latest release, The Paradise, during a press meet in Hyderabad. He credited the film's success to the relentless dedication of the entire crew, assistant directors, and technicians including music composer Anirudh and editor Navin Nooli. Describing the project as a long runner, Nani also lauded director Srikanth Odela and co-stars like Mohan Babu and Priyadarshi.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise the Deadliest of His Career
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu shared his admiration for director Srikanth Odela and lead actor Nani during a media interaction for The Paradise in Hyderabad. Marking his five-decade career, the senior actor revealed that his role in the film was his deadliest yet, requiring the most retakes he has ever faced. He also praised producer Sudhakar Cherukuri for backing the movie without compromising on the budget.

news.title: Nani Highlights The Unusual Box-Office Trajectory Of The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani shared his astonishment over the audience reception for his latest film, The Paradise, directed by Srikanth Odela. Unlike standard box-office trends, public sentiment for the movie notably shifted from negative to positive as successive shows played out. The big-budget project features an ensemble cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, Sonali Kulkarni, and Kayadu Lohar under Sudhakar Cherukuri's production.
